name: deploy-dev
description: Docker compose setup for dev environment

scripts.dev: concurrently -n caddy,clients,identity,notes -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run scripts:core:caddy" "npm run scripts:core:clients" "npm run scripts:core:identity" "npm run scripts:core:notes"
scripts.dev:with-monitoring: concurrently -n caddy,clients,identity,notes,prometheus,grafana,loki,node_exporter -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red,white,gray "npm run scripts:core:caddy" "npm run scripts:core:clients" "npm run scripts:core:identity" "npm run scripts:core:notes" "npm run scripts:monitoring:prometheus" "npm run scripts:monitoring:grafana" "npm run scripts:monitoring:loki" "npm run scripts:monitoring:node_exporter"
scripts.scripts:core:clients: dotenv -e env.dev -- sh -c 'cd ../../clients/spas && npm run dev'
scripts.scripts:core:identity: dotenv -e env.dev -- sh -c 'cd ../../services/identity && npm run start'
scripts.scripts:core:notes: dotenv -e env.dev -- sh -c 'cd ../../services/notes/notes-service && npm run start'
scripts.scripts:monitoring:grafana: dotenv -e env.dev -- sh -c 'GRAFANA_BIN=$(which grafana); GRAFANA_STORE=$(dirname $(dirname "$GRAFANA_BIN")); GF_SERVER_HTTP_ADDR=${GRAFANA_HOST%%:*} GF_SERVER_HTTP_PORT=${GRAFANA_HOST##*:} grafana server --homepath="$GRAFANA_STORE/share/grafana" --config=./grafana/grafana.ini'
